description: Which bitcoin custody models fit a described situation, by Proof of Custody's published rules, and which platforms run each fitting model by published score. Inputs are banded (amount, who must recover it, what they can do, holder type, jurisdiction, usage, the failure feared most, willingness to let institutions hold keys, budget, where it is now). Returns models with every rule that fired, the recovery steps each model demands, platforms with source links, and the procurement briefs to run. Structures, not advice: it never picks one provider. Use for 'my spouse cannot run a hardware wallet, what works', 'custody for an LLC', 'I have 100 BTC on one device and three heirs', or any question that starts from a person's situation.

fear.description: The failure that worries you most

recoverer.description: Who must be able to recover it if you cannot

name: fit_custody_setup
